title: Thinking on the Smiqql Acquisition Deck
summary: Kahran and Divya open up Smiqql's actual acquisition deck — the one Dina Holzapfel used to sell the cookie business — and read it page by page on camera, the first in a new format where they brainstorm out loud over an artifact. They unpack what an acquisition story needs (the business numbers plus the customer story), why this deck reads serious instead of fun, and how founders often forget the audience doesn't have all their context.
topics: Smiqql sale to a strategic acquirer
brand voice in a serious moment
first video episode of the podcast
decisions about what to leave out

intents.display: to learn how to read and tighten a real acquisition deck
